name: Madhepura

queries.query: Madhepura Bihar official cadastral map land records parcel GIS site:gov.in
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, the Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms portal, the official Madhepura district land-records page, and the Government of India DILRMP map-digitization record for Madhepura.

queries.query: बिहार मधेपुरा आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा भू-अभिलेख
queries.result: First-party Hindi discovery identified the Hindi Madhepura district revenue/land-record page and BiharBhumi portal. The official BhuNaksha viewer exposes Hindi hierarchy labels and public cadastral-map routes.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery followed by TLS-verified anonymous GET/POST inspection of the current BhuNaksha HTML, JavaScript and public REST routes. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Bihar cadastral mapping viewer; current HTML loads public JavaScript and exposes hierarchy, map extent, plot lookup and WMS routes.
Official Madhepura district page identifies BiharBhumi as the land-record service and states that Madhepura has 13 circles; it is custodian/service prose, not an open parcel-vector endpoint.
Official DILRMP record for Bihar, Madhepura, Madhepura tehsil; it reports village-level cadastral-map digitization fields and Bhu-Naksha usage status.

requests.assessment: Viewer HTML retrieved. It references config.js, index.js, public REST hierarchy/map routes, ScalarDatahandler and WMS.
Returned map-instance counts [14501,5569,4630,3713,1995,963,48722,72681,735,47,638]. This confirms public service metadata, not parcel features.
Returned Hindi labels for district, subdivision, circle, mauza, survey type, map instance and sheet number.

requests.assessment: Returned Bihar hierarchy metadata including district code 11 MADHEPURA, subdivision code 02 मधेपुरा, circle code 01 Madhepura, and a bounded mauza list. The response contains native location codes/names, but no parcel ID-plus-geometry feature was retained.

Returned an error page in the direct request; the browser JavaScript route itself was inspected and hierarchy REST calls were used instead.
